title: Test-set metrics
description: SEAM 4. results/metrics/<run_id>/test_metrics.json - accuracy, precision, recall and confusion matrix on the held-out test split. Produced by Member 1 (scripts/evaluate.py) for EVERY model, so that all four models are scored by the same code. Consumed by Member 4 for the Section 4 and Section 6 tables and the confusion-matrix figures. Committed to git.

split.description: Locked to 'test'. Reported headline metrics come from the held-out split only.

macro_precision.description: Unweighted mean of per-class precision. Macro rather than micro because micro-averaged precision equals accuracy for single-label classification, which would make the Section 4 table report the same number twice.

per_class.description: Keyed by class name. Drives the report's discussion of which classes get confused.

confusion_matrix.description: Square, raw counts (not normalised). Orientation is FROZEN: confusion_matrix[i][j] is the number of samples whose TRUE class is i and whose PREDICTED class is j. Rows therefore sum to each class's support. Row and column indices align with class_names.

num_samples.description: Test images evaluated. Must equal the sum of the confusion matrix and split_meta.json.counts.test.

checkpoint.description: Which checkpoint was evaluated, normally artifacts/checkpoints/<run_id>/best.pt.
